comment: **Four repositories that were released separately, in four languages, pinned by commit.**
A cross-repository question is only a cross-repository question if the repositories are real: a fixture whose
imports the author already knew how to resolve is one repository written twice. These four are downloaded from
GitHub at the commit named here and never committed, so a run measures the revision the file names rather than a
**Pinned by commit and not by tag.** A tag would have been chosen because it looks stable; the commit is what was
in front of the indexer on the day the corpus was built, and the artifact can be re-derived from it exactly.
**The languages are the ones the product claims**, and each brings its own doc-comment convention: Python
docstrings, JSDoc in JavaScript and TypeScript, Javadoc in Java. Questions are derived from those comments, so the
corpus tests four conventions rather than four spellings of one.

repositories.role: typed HTTP client, JSDoc with tags
